get.description: Returns all non-deleted sales ordered by most recent first.

post.description: Creates a sale with one or more line items. The total is computed from unit prices × quantities. Returns 400 if the computed total is not positive.

get.description: Returns a single non-deleted sale by its ID.

put.description: Partially updates a sale. Only the fields provided are changed. For lines: existing item IDs update their quantity; new item IDs are added (name and unit_price required); items not mentioned are kept unchanged. The total is recomputed. The change is recorded in sale_history. Requires manager access.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a sale by setting is_deleted=true. The deletion is recorded in sale_history. Requires manager access.

get.description: Returns the audit trail of changes for a sale, ordered most-recent-first. Each row captures the state of the sale after the change was applied, alongside a diff of what changed (fields "action", and any modified field with from/to values). Requires manager access.
get.summary: List the change history of a sale

post.description: Creates a new store linked to the authenticated account. Also creates the first admin profile with an auto-generated PIN.

get.description: Returns all stores owned by the currently authenticated account.
Retrieves the details of a store using its ID. Only the owner can access.

delete.description: Deletes a store and all its profiles. Only the owner can delete.
